title: Kentucky Shakespeare

services.name: School Programs
services.desc: The most comprehensive in-school arts education provider in the Commonwealth, we provide interactive performances, touring productions, arts workshops and residencies, and professional development for educators. Let our talented performers educate and entertain your students! Perfect for school assemblies or shared grade level content, our educational performances are 50-90 minutes long and include in-depth guided discussions that touch on key topics from school curriculum and academic standards. “There was a star danced, and under that was I born.” One of Shakespeare’s most famous comedies!
